standard_prerequisites.name: Adjoint pair with unit and counit
standard_prerequisites.statement: An adjunction between functors U and V with unit eta and counit epsilon, fulfilling the triangle identities (the author's Situation situation-adjoint-functors, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: The system X is built from alternating composites of eta and epsilon, and the computations use the triangle identities (source lines 6893-6897, 6900-6937).

standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial object in a functor category
standard_prerequisites.statement: A sequence of functors with face and degeneracy maps satisfying the simplicial identities.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is what the lemma asserts of the system X and what the proof verifies (source lines 6894-6895, 6905-6933).

standard_prerequisites.name: Augmentation to the constant simplicial object
standard_prerequisites.statement: A morphism from a simplicial object to the constant simplicial object at a given value, compatible with all the structure maps.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the second assertion of the lemma (source lines 6896-6897).

core_obligations: Describe the system and its structure maps: record how X_n and its face and degeneracy maps are built from the unit and counit of the adjunction, and how the augmentation is defined by the first counit (source lines 6900-6910).

Verify the simplicial identities: check the face-degeneracy identities by reducing each side to a composite of the unit with itself, using the triangle identities of the adjunction, and conclude that both sides agree (source lines 6910-6936).
Conclude: deduce that X is a simplicial object of the functor category and that the counit defines an augmentation (source lines 6936-6937).

proof_roadmap.step: Record the system X, its structure maps and the augmentation.
Verify the simplicial identities by reducing both sides to eta star eta.
Conclude the simplicial structure and the augmentation.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-standard-simplicial at source lines 6891-6898: in the standing situation of an adjoint pair, the system X = (X_n, face maps, degeneracy maps) built from alternating composites of the unit and counit is a simplicial object of the functor category, and the first counit defines an augmentation from X to the constant simplicial object at the identity functor. The proof at source lines 6900-6937 is a verification of the simplicial identities, which in this situation are concrete computations with unit-counit composites. The two identities checked are the face-degeneracy one and the middle face-degeneracy one, and in each case the proof reduces the claim to an equality of two composites of the unit with itself, which holds because both sides are the same expression. Recognising which composite reduces to which standard identity is the substance, and the statement mentions none of the identities. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
